row.title: MOBILE-LAYOUT-1: phone header budget lives in core/ui
row.body: core/ui siteHeader keeps items flagged primary in the bar and puts the rest under a script-free More disclosure; familyBar shows its text before the colon on phones. Tenants enforce a 390px budget (chrome <=170px, h1 inside first screen, no sideways scroll, 44px header targets) with a browser check in CI.
